name: RevitMCPCommandSet
description: Basic command collection for Revit AI assistance

commands.description: Displays a greeting dialog
get available family types
get current view elements
get current view info
get selected elements
Create point-based elements like furniture
Create line based element such as wall
Create surface-based elements like floors
Color elements by parameter value
Tag all the walls in the model
Deletes elements using ElementId
AI element filter for querying elements by criteria
Operate on elements (select, color, hide, isolate, etc)
Extract all rooms with detailed properties including area, volume, perimeter, and parameters
Calculate material quantities and takeoffs with area and volume calculations per material
Analyze model complexity with element counts by category, type, family, and level
Create grid system with smart spacing generation for project layout (alphabetic/numeric naming)
Create structural beam framing system with configurable spacing and direction
Create and place rooms at specified locations with custom names, numbers, and properties
Create tags for all rooms in the current view displaying room name and number
Create levels at specified elevations with automatic floor plan view generation
Execute dynamic C# code in Revit with access to the Document and Revit API
Create dimension annotations between elements or points in the current view
Formcraft: open documents and the active document
Formcraft: create a family, project or template from a template and save it
Formcraft: save an open non-workshared document to a checked path
Formcraft: close an open document that is not active
Formcraft: open a detached verification copy in the background without saving
Formcraft: build data-shell families from resolved plans (FMC_Family_Specs.json)
Formcraft: load, place and flex staged families in the chain-test project and check connectors and parameters
Formcraft: Gate A host test (F-061): in a new project never saved, place the family on a wall face or ceiling, move the host, check it follows, stays upright and its connectors point into the host
Formcraft: builds many checked recipes in one Revit job (fmc_recipe batch, F-063): apply, flex, archive the old staged file, save to staging with the recipe, one result line per family

Formcraft: a role's chain-test project from its template: every staged family placed on its host, keynote-tagged, a keynote legend and type schedules on a sheet, saved to 04_Families\_ChainTests (F-064 #6)
Formcraft: read and steer the Formcraft pane for UI tests (never touches the model)
Formcraft: read a template for the audit (shared parameters, styles, sizes, warnings)
Formcraft: brand pack fonts on a staging template (dry run first)
Formcraft: read the families loaded in the active project (read-only)
Formcraft: read an outside family file (size, imported CAD, types, parameters)
Formcraft: kit parameters and keynote onto an outside family, saved to library staging
Formcraft: read what the QA rules check in the active model (read-only)
Formcraft: a planned room (walls, openings, families, ceiling, room) built in the active model, replacing what its tree node built before
Formcraft: a room's walls, doors, windows and services points, read for a casework run (read only)
Formcraft: casework units placed as the kit's FMC_I_Casework_* family types with FMC_Assembly_Mark, FMC_Carcass_Spec and FMC_Worktop_Spec, in one Undo (dry run rolls back)
Formcraft: casework shop drawings: a front elevation per unit on the register's A3 sheets, the I11_Joinery_Cutlist schedule placed, the sheets exported as PDF (dry run rolls back)
Formcraft: a review ticket's place: its elements selected and shown, your own review view on its camera and box
Formcraft: select and show elements (a QA result zoom)
Formcraft: the model materials, use and texture paths (read-only)
Formcraft: a database material onto types (dry run first)
Formcraft: delete materials nothing uses (dry run first)
Formcraft: every sheet, views placed and title block fields (read-only)
Formcraft: the register missing sheets with a title block (dry run first)
Formcraft: sheet names from the register (dry run first)
Formcraft: text types, line patterns, dimension types and tag families (read-only)
Formcraft: untagged doors, windows, rooms and electrical fixtures in the view or sheet (read-only)
Formcraft: revisions and each sheet's current revision (read-only)
Formcraft: one PDF per sheet into the issue folder (the model is not changed)
Formcraft: coordinates, Revit links and worksets (read-only)
Formcraft: link models from 02_Shared by shared coordinates (behind the lock)
Formcraft: pin links (behind the lock)
Formcraft: coordination snapshot, align or place (align and place change the model only when dry_run is false; behind the lock)
Formcraft: reload one Revit link type with no transaction phase (behind the lock)
Formcraft: unload one Revit link type with no transaction phase (behind the lock)
Formcraft: detached Save As of a link copy. Does not save, sync or activate an open model (behind the lock)
Formcraft: read or write Revit link paths on a closed file via TransmissionData. Does not open the file
Formcraft: boards, loads, circuits and feeders, devices on no circuit (read-only)
Formcraft: analytical model, supports, kit fields, load cases and analysis results (read-only)
Formcraft E1: rooms, plumbing fixtures, pipe systems, tanks, fire devices, LP parts and circuits for the MEP calculations (read-only)
Formcraft: devices grouped into circuits on a named board, the kit's distribution system set if the board has none; never sizes (dry run unless dry_run is false; behind the lock)
Formcraft line diagrams: one system graph per diagram from Revit's own connections, with gaps (read-only)
Formcraft line diagrams: drafting views from a draw spec, redrawn in place, notes kept (dry run unless dry_run is false; never saves)
Formcraft line diagrams: the Sheet Register sheets with the kit's title block and the drawn diagram views placed (dry run unless dry_run is false; never saves)
Formcraft line diagrams (Gate D): the drafting views holding items fmc_diagram drew, with their source keys and TBC texts (read-only)
Formcraft: quantities by kit code, status and package counts, unmapped elements (read-only)
Formcraft: each element type's category, for the AI-assisted modeller (read-only)
Formcraft: a new template in staging from a seed (Phase 1; staging only)
Formcraft: one layer of the kit's base recipe on a template in staging (dry run unless told; staging only)
Formcraft: the names a template holds, for compare (read-only)
Formcraft: the analytical model for Robot, members, ends, types, sizes, materials and grades (read-only)
Formcraft: Robot's results into FMC_FEA_NEd_kN, FMC_FEA_MEd_kNm and FMC_FEA_Run_Ref, never the approval (behind the lock)
Formcraft: start from brief on a new model, levels, Project Information, unplaced rooms, families (behind the lock)
Formcraft: worksharing state, user worksets and warnings (read-only)
Formcraft: create user worksets named by the rule (behind the lock; never syncs)
Formcraft: the model, active view and selected elements for a review item (read-only)
Formcraft: the model's design option sets and options, and which one is active (read-only; options side by side)
Formcraft: a schedule set made or updated in the active template or WIP model; only missing fields added, nothing deleted (dry run rolled back)
Formcraft: checkout status and central currency of named elements (read-only; never checks an element out or grants an editing request)
Formcraft: marked elements' category, type, parameters (mm) and the types they can change to, for a ticket's fix plan (read-only)
Formcraft: a ticket's planned fix applied in one transaction after a person's yes (behind the lock; all or nothing)
Formcraft: a list of model edits (delete, move, parameters, types, attach, roofs, railings, stairs, room lines, openings) as one approved batch and one Undo (behind the lock; all or nothing)
Formcraft: elements' exact location, level, bounding box and outline loops in mm (read-only)
Formcraft: starts one of Revit's built-in commands by name, optionally with elements selected first (behind the lock)
Formcraft: Revit's built-in commands and whether each can start now (read-only)
Formcraft: a new family from a Revit family template, saved and opened in the Family Editor
Formcraft: save, open, close, export, link, import, load families, sync and reload (behind the lock)
Formcraft: a PNG of a view, or of a 3D close-up around elements with them highlighted (read-only; rolled back)
Formcraft: model problems with ids, places and a sentence each: warnings, duplicates, rooms, unhosted, walls, clashes (read-only)
Formcraft: undo the AI's own last batches in Revit, never a person's work (behind the lock)
Formcraft: Revit's undo list as the AI sees it, the AI's batches and a person's changes (read-only)

Formcraft: what the structure must carry, from the architecture model or its link: levels, walls with layers, floors, roofs, rooms, members (read-only). column_ends adds each structural column's solid ends after cuts and joins, and the elements touching those ends.
Formcraft: preview a structural replacement on an open_copy document only. One transaction group, always rolled back, never saved. Creates, verifies, rebinds, deletes exact ids and checks orphans.

Formcraft: run a kit Dynamo graph in-process through Dynamo for Revit (late-bound). Preview rolls the transaction group back. Apply keeps it. Neither saves. Status reports whether Dynamo for Revit is loaded.
Formcraft: a 3D view as FBX plus materials, extent and camera, for Blender renders (files in WIP; the model is not changed)
Formcraft: what makes the model heavy to draw: textures, surface patterns, unused materials, heavy families (read-only)
Formcraft: elements by category, level, type, family, comment, mark, workset, phase, box or view (read-only)
Formcraft: a revision cloud around a review item's elements (dry run first; behind the lock)
Formcraft asset builder: open a background family from a template or staging (the server checks paths)
Formcraft asset builder: what an open session's document holds (read-only)
Formcraft asset builder: PNGs of a session's 3D and front views
Formcraft asset builder: save a session to a staging path the server checked
Formcraft asset builder: close a session without saving
Formcraft asset builder: a batch of named ops on a session (dry run unless dry_run is false)
Formcraft asset builder: flex every type of a session's family; nothing is kept
Formcraft asset builder: the sessions held and other background family documents (read-only)
Formcraft systems flow tracer: leak test, continuity, missing parts and standards verdicts (read-only, no transaction)
Formcraft systems flow tracer: apply a dry-run correction plan in one transaction, and roll it back if the failure count rises
Formcraft ceilings (CL2): a ceiling design placed in one transaction: I.CLG ceilings per zone, line features where families are loaded, fixtures as marks only (dry run is the real run rolled back)
Formcraft ceilings (CL2): what the last place made replaced by the design as it is now, one Undo (dry run first)
Formcraft hub: elements by mark, number or name, and what touches them (read-only)
Formcraft hardware and memory: graphics settings, per-document memory, and closing spare views. It does not move the model onto the GPU.
Formcraft phases: phases, phase filters, revisions and a compact element summary (read-only)
Formcraft phases: one transaction for a phase or revision plan (dry run stays on the server)
Formcraft joins: wall joins, hosting, room closure and an envelope pressure test (read-only)
Formcraft joins: one transaction for a join plan (dry run stays on the server, at most 50 operations)
Formcraft circuits: unassigned power and lighting devices, panels and existing circuits (read-only)
Formcraft circuits: one transaction to create circuits or set a panel. One subtransaction per circuit.
Formcraft conduit: free ends, the size table and loaded fitting types (read-only)
Formcraft conduit: fittings, sizes and type fittings. One subtransaction per fitting.
Formcraft clash scan: chunked bounding boxes, optional exact solids, JSONL output (read-only)
Formcraft documents: list open documents and probe a file (read-only)
Formcraft documents: open a model (a workshared central as a new local) or close one. Does not save a protected path.
Formcraft memory: free MB, Revit working set and open documents including families (read-only)
Formcraft memory: close unmodified spare documents, or purge unused elements from a PerformanceAdviser rule.
Formcraft true north: angle, survey point, view orientation and grid angles (read-only, never changes project north)
Formcraft true north: one transaction to rotate a crop, a scope box or a sheet north arrow. Does not change project north.
Formcraft legends: legend views and legend components (read-only)
Formcraft legends: one transaction to duplicate a seed legend view or copy and retype a seed component. No text notes.
Formcraft typical details: resolve the open project before a kit detail is copied (read-only)
Formcraft typical details: one transaction to copy a kit detail into a drafting view. The kit file is not saved.
Formcraft family parameters: list parameters on a family loaded in the project (read-only, the family file is not saved)
Formcraft family parameters: add a parameter or label on the loaded family, or bind a project parameter. The kit file is not saved.
Formcraft headroom: clear height under beams, ducts, pipes and soffits (read-only, no transaction)
Formcraft keynotes: linked tags, plan views and hosts (read-only). Does not create a keynote link.
Formcraft keynotes: one transaction to copy a linked seed into each plan and retarget the host. A blank copy is rolled back.
Formcraft sheets: title block, view sizes and sheet parameters (read-only).
Formcraft sheets: one transaction to place or arrange views, or set the Parked sheet parameter.
Formcraft view graphics: templates, filters and room names (read-only).
Formcraft view graphics: one transaction for a view template, a parameter filter, or a room colour scheme.
Formcraft dimensions: grids, exterior walls and openings in one view (read-only).
Formcraft dimensions: one transaction, one subtransaction per dimension string.
Formcraft drawing register: sheet list fields, filters and parked sheets (read-only).
Formcraft drawing register: one transaction to filter PARKED sheets out of a sheet list.
Formcraft batch undo: whether created elements still exist and are editable (read-only).
Formcraft batch undo: one transaction that deletes elements this batch created.
